summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Pan American Silver Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, announcing the release date for its Q1 2026 unaudited results and the scheduling of its Annual General and Special Meeting of Shareholders on April 30, 2026. The filing includes a news release and references to the management information circular and proxy materials. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine corporate update with no structural or transactional event triggering a special-situation classification.
